policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: O updates GPT-5.6 deployment safety for August releases
items.summary: O’s Deployment Safety Hub posted August updates for GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna, stating they are treated as high capability in specified domains under its Preparedness Framework.

items.headline: O: model-safety policy—Preparedness Framework rewrite
items.summary: O said it is rewriting its Preparedness Framework security document as model capability thresholds near/approach earlier critical levels defined in 2023-era guidance.

items.headline: G: closes $350M Series A; values G at $3.5B
items.summary: G announced a $350M Series A led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation, valuing the company at $3.5B; it also stated total 2026 funding includes $650M from June.

items.headline: G: G joins NVIDIA Cloud Partner program
items.summary: G said it joined NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP), framing certification as validation that its infrastructure can deploy and operate NVIDIA-accelerated computing to NCP standards.
